brief.text: Manchester City have been found guilty of financial breaches, and Arsenal are waiting on the final sanction. Talk of a £200m windfall heading to the Emirates is only a rumour for now, so don't spend it yet. The Julian Alvarez story has more to it than the usual gossip: reports say Arsenal have a clear run after a sporting director gave the green light, so it's moving but still well short of "Here we go." Viktor Gyokeres scored for Sweden yet still looked fed up, and he has admitted some frustration at Arsenal while being honest about his future, while Thomas Tuchel has confirmed an issue with Declan Rice on England duty, which is the one to watch before the weekend.
